row.evidence: Customer.io's pricing page marks "SSO & 2-factor authentication" as included on Essentials, Premium and Enterprise, and its SSO docs say that once a SAML integration is authenticated you can set up SCIM 2.0 provisioning, with no plan gate stated.
row.notes: Flat, profile-based pricing: Essentials from $100/mo billed monthly, Premium from $1,000/mo billed yearly, Enterprise via sales; unlimited team members, so per-user fields are null. SSO is on every plan; SCIM 2.0 rides on a SAML SSO integration (tested SAML IdPs: Okta, JumpCloud, Cloudflare; Google and Azure SAML not supported, they use Google/OIDC sign-in instead). No plan restriction on SCIM is documented, so status is free at medium confidence. Group management not supported; roles managed only in Customer.io. Okta's OIN Customer.io app is SWA/OIDC only; SCIM uses a custom SAML app. No JIT. No team-member or audit-log API.

deprovision.notes: Removing a user in the IdP removes the team member; deleting a team member invalidates their sessions (stated for manual deletion).

roles.how: Roles and permissions managed only in Customer.io

limitations.text: SCIM only works on a SAML integration; Google and Azure SAML are marked not supported.
Okta does not provision users assigned before SCIM was enabled.

user_api.notes: The App API (api.customer.io) covers messaging, broadcasts and customer-profile data, not team members; no team-member endpoints in its OpenAPI spec.

okta.notes: OIN app marks SWA and OIDC only. SCIM is done through a custom SAML 2.0 app per Customer.io docs.

entra.notes: Entra sign-in via OIDC; Azure SAML (needed for SCIM) marked not supported.

google.notes: Sign in with Google for organizations; Google SAML marked not supported.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud catalogue page returned 403; facts from Customer.io's JumpCloud SCIM steps.
